units.source_text: 她言外之意似乎是：像你这样的流浪汉，我才看不上呢……

en.t: What she seemed to imply was: I would never be interested in a wanderer like you...

units.source_text: 然而，即使在侮辱人的时候，她那双圆圆的眼睛也显得十分妩媚。

en.t: Yet even when she was insulting someone, her round eyes looked very charming.

units.source_text: 阿雪又用扇子遮掩着脸面舞了起来。

en.t: Oyuki again covered her face with the fan and began to dance.

units.source_text: 仓吉泛起浅浅的微笑，用阿雪扔过来的扇子拍打着大腿。

en.t: Kurakichi gave a faint smile and tapped his thigh with the fan Oyuki had tossed to him.

units.source_text: 他的脚很白皙，肉乎乎的，加上脸红唇厚，活像个胖墩墩的四十开外的女人。

en.t: His feet were pale and plump, and with his red face and thick lips he looked just like a chubby woman past forty.

units.source_text: 他的长相同身上那件带商号的和服短褂很不相称，却令人感到很有力量，好似一只肥壮而迟钝的走兽。

en.t: His appearance was quite at odds with the short kimono coat bearing the shop name, yet he gave an impression of strength, like a fat, sluggish beast.
